title: Postcards — Angles
description: post-cards/data/theme/angles.json. letterDegrees is the candidate tilt list for a postcard, indexed directly by date-hash modulo its length (HashUtils.pickByModulo) — shared by the letter's own tilt and its ghost-stack card, so both always agree. Its order is deliberately shuffled (not sorted) so that modulo picking doesn't cluster nearby dates on nearby angles.
